summary: NetClass Technology Inc (Nasdaq: NTCL, Cayman-incorporated, Singapore-based) filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering priced at $0.40 per Class A ordinary share (last sale $0.38 on November 4, 2026), with pre-funded warrants at $0.3875 (exercise price $0.0125). Terms cover 675,000 shares, pre-funded warrants for up to 2,325,000 shares, and 3,000,000 allocation rights exercisable within 30 days of initial closing for additional shares/warrants at the same prices, under a November 5, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement. Univest Securities is placement agent on a reasonable best-efforts basis. This is a routine ordinary shelf takedown/equity capital raise, not a special situation; watch dilution and the 30-day allocation-right overhang.
